run_plot_cli: run the plot.py script with a TSV or CSV log file to generate a terminal plot
run_plot_with_smoothing: run the plot.py script with --smoothing cumsum to apply cumulative moving average smoothing
run_plot_with_errorbars: run the plot.py script with --errorbars flag to display error bars on the plot
load_file_function: load a TSV or CSV file and extract x/y arrays with rolling window smoothing applied
plot_function: plot multiple x/y data series using gnuplotlib with configurable terminal size and axis ranges
